title: LinkRefusal
description: A refused Link request: the envelope with data null and a machine code in error. A device acts on the code alone (each is described under $defs); meta is diagnostics for people. A code the device doesn't know is a refusal it can't retry. Maina Link protocol v1. Generated from src/link/protocol/**; do not edit (adr/0008).

meta.description: Diagnostics: a message a person can read, a retry time, the offending name. Other keys may appear.

invalid_request.description: The body is not the protocol message the route takes. Fix the request; don't retry it as is.

authorization_pending.description: Enrolment: no member has approved the user code yet. Keep polling enrol/complete every `interval` seconds until the code expires.

slow_down.description: Enrolment: the device polls too fast (RFC 8628). Add 5 seconds to the polling interval and keep polling.

expired_code.description: Enrolment: the device or user code is past its 10 minutes. Start a new enrolment.

invalid_grant.description: Enrolment: the device code is unknown or already used, or the key is already enrolled. Start a new enrolment with a new key.

already_approved.description: Enrolment: the user code was already approved (answered to the approving member).

invalid_proof.description: Enrolment: the proof of possession doesn't verify with the presented public key.

org_keys_unavailable.description: Enrolment: the org verification keys a device pins aren't available (a dark signer); nothing was written. Keep polling with the same code.

enrol_unavailable.description: Enrolment: the cloud can't take enrolments right now (a missing or failing rate limiter). Retry later.

ci_token_required.description: CI enrolment: a `ci` device must present a CI-enrolment API token.

ci_scope_required.description: CI enrolment: the token isn't an API token scoped to device.enrol.ci.

unknown_device.description: Token exchange: no device has this id. Re-enrol.

device_revoked.description: The device was revoked; every Link call is refused from now on. Stop Link and re-enrol.

invalid_signature.description: A device signature doesn't verify with the device's enrolled key.

stale_challenge.description: Token exchange: the challenge's `ts` is more than 5 minutes from the cloud's clock. Check the clock and sign a fresh challenge.

challenge_replayed.description: Token exchange: the challenge's nonce was already used. Sign a fresh challenge.

missing_token.description: No access token was presented. Buy a token (POST /link/v1/token) and retry once.

invalid_token.description: The access token is unknown. Buy a fresh token and retry once.

token_expired.description: The access token is past its expiry. Buy a fresh token and retry once.

device_mismatch.description: A signed message names another device than the access token's.

forbidden.description: Not allowed (a member without device.enrol, say).

no_policy.description: Policy pull: nothing is published for the device's scope yet. Keep the last good bundle, if any.

policy_conflict.description: Policy pull: the scope's published layers don't compile together. Keep the last good bundle until an admin fixes a layer.

not_found.description: The thing asked for doesn't exist (an unknown schema file, say).

schema_version_not_found.description: Schemas: no published file has the pinned sha256. Pin a published manifest.

rate_limited.description: Too many requests. Retry after `meta.retryAt` when it is given.

internal.description: A storage or signer failure in the cloud; never a pass. Retry later.
